item.title: fix(google): reject malformed video operation JSON (#115465)
item.summary: fix(google): reject malformed video operation JSON (#115465) * fix(google): reject malformed video operation JSON * fix(google): reuse shared provider JSON reader for video operations Route successful Google video operation responses through the canonical readProviderJsonResponse so fatal UTF-8 decoding and malformed-JSON wrapping stay on the shared provider contract. Keep the lenient non-OK detail path.
